problem.title: Moving Average from Data Stream
problem.problemStatement: Design a data structure that calculates the moving average of the last size values from a stream of integers. For each incoming value, return the average of the most recent size elements currently in the window.
problem.input: Integer size Integer q Next q integers representing the stream.
problem.output: For each inserted value, print the current moving average.
